channel.title: TopChinaCar News
channel.description: Chinese auto news, EVs, exports, policy and global market coverage from TopChinaCar.

item.title: Changan Plans Brazil Expansion as BYD Adds a Third Shift and Li Auto Signs Asian Partners
item.description: Changan plans eight new models in Brazil in 2027, while BYD adds about 2,000 workers with a third shift in Bahia. Li Auto's five new Asia-Pacific partnerships underline the work behind overseas launches.

item.title: China Auto Retail Falls 27.1% as BMW Sets Launch Dates and Suppliers Advance Investment Plans
item.description: Final CPCA figures put October passenger-car retail sales at 1.643 million. BMW sets China launch dates, WEY and Fang Cheng Bao open pre-sales or reservations, and suppliers disclose new plans.

item.title: BYD Shows Robotic Charging in UAE as October Export Data Reveal Scale and Market Divergence
item.description: BYD demonstrated a reportedly 1,000 kW robotic charging system in the UAE. New CPCA figures detail October NEV exports, while Geely's Mexico sales and Chery Q's Thai deliveries show how local outcomes differ.

item.title: Yangwang Opens Altior China Pre-orders as GWM Details ORA 7 Body Plans
item.description: Yangwang's Altior limited edition requires a RMB 300,000 deposit in China. GWM confirms coupe-style and wagon bodies for the ORA 7; both remain product developments ahead of launch or delivery.

item.title: Jetour Details African Factory Footprint as MG Records 7,082 Indian Retail Sales
item.description: Jetour expects South African T2 production in mid-2027. Indian October retail figures show 7,082 vehicles for MG and 737 for BYD, while a Denza D9 appears in Mumbai ahead of local specifications.

item.title: Mercedes-Benz, Subaru and Porsche File China Recalls as Geely and Fang Cheng Bao Expand Lineups
item.description: Subaru's recall covers 196,494 imported cars, while Mercedes-Benz separates immediate and later remedies. Geely adds RMB 91,800 Xingyuan editions and Fang Cheng Bao outlines production and product plans.

item.title: Changan Plans Deeper Thai Sourcing as Leapmotor Launches SUVs in Mexico
item.description: Changan targets over 60% local sourcing in Thailand, while Leapmotor launches two SUVs in Mexico. Yangwang unveils its Altior flagship and GAC reports 223,100 year-to-date own-brand exports.

item.title: SAIC Forms Momenta-Led ADAS Venture as MIIT Drafts Battery Digital ID Rules
item.description: SAIC Motor approved a RMB 300 million driver-assistance joint venture in which Momenta will hold 51%, MIIT released draft battery digital ID rules, Chery recalled 53,882 vehicles in China and Tesla put Giga Shanghai localization at 98%.

item.title: BYD's Yangwang Breaks 500 km/h in Abu Dhabi as 14 MEPs Seek EU Security Review of BYD
item.description: Yangwang's U9 Xtreme hit 503.17 km/h on public roads in Abu Dhabi, while 14 MEPs asked Brussels to assess BYD's security risks. Xiaomi EV set up an International Business Division ahead of its 2027 entry into Europe.

item.title: BYD Cuts Seal 07 Entry Prices as Volvo's China Dealer Network Shrinks
item.description: BYD's second-gen Seal 07 starts at 139,900 yuan, while a Jiemian probe finds Volvo dealers quoting XC70 prices below 200,000 yuan after Q3 Greater China deliveries fell 40.6% to 20,300. Zeekr, Jetour and Smart also launched models.

item.title: Jaecoo 7 Tops UK Sales Again as BYD Passes 10,000 in Australia and Yangwang Heads to Abu Dhabi
item.description: Chery's Jaecoo 7 was Britain's best-selling car for a second month with 3,412 registrations, BYD sold 10,025 cars in Australia in October, and Geely hit a record ninth place there.

item.title: Changan Seeks Outside Investors for Tech Unit as BAIC BluePark Narrows Q3 Loss
item.description: Changan Automobile plans to bring investors into its wholly owned Changan Technology unit, BAIC BluePark's Q3 revenue rose 15.23% as its loss narrowed 17.5%, Foton's Q3 profit fell 28.11%, and GAC addressed "rushed car" concerns.

item.title: Leapmotor Takes the A10 to Thailand and Malaysia as Chery Weighs a London Home for Jaecoo
item.description: Leapmotor launched the A10 (B03X) in Thailand and will CKD-assemble it in Malaysia, after exporting 27,454 cars in September. Chery is considering London as Jaecoo's headquarters after the Jaecoo 7 topped UK sales.

item.title: Changan Swings to Loss and GAC's Deficit Widens as Q3 Reports Expose Profit Squeeze in China
item.description: Changan posted a Q3 net loss of RMB 758 million, GAC's quarterly loss widened to RMB 2.52 billion and Great Wall's profit fell 40.75%, while Japanese automakers' China output dropped 32% in April–September.

item.title: Changan Hits Record Overseas Quarter as Currency Losses Squeeze Chinese Automakers' Q3 Profits
item.description: Changan sold a record 270,000 cars abroad in Q3 (+64.33%), and SAIC's Jan–Sep overseas sales hit 1.166 million, but FX losses and a delayed overseas subsidy cut into profits at Changan, SAIC and GWM.

item.title: BYD's Q3 Profit Rises 28% as SAIC's Falls 77%; Volkswagen China Unveils VEGA Tech Matrix
item.description: BYD's Q3 net profit rose 28.08% to RMB 10.02 billion and Geely's core profit rose 32%, while SAIC Motor's Q3 net profit fell 76.7%. Volkswagen China launched its VEGA technology matrix, and Dongfeng signed a new pact with CATL.

item.title: Geely's Overseas Sales Jump 169% as GAC Starts Battery Production in Thailand
item.description: Geely sold 797,670 cars outside China in Jan–Sep, up 169%, while GAC's battery arm Inpow rolled out its first Thai-built pack. Chery's Tiggo 2 got zero stars from Latin NCAP, and Chinese brands kept expanding in Australia.

item.title: China Car Retail Falls 26% in Late October as Industry Profit Drops 23%; Li Auto, BYD Refresh Key Models
item.description: CPCA data show passenger car retail at 1.145 million units on Oct 1-25, down 26% year on year, while auto industry profit fell 23% in January-September. Li Auto and BYD launched updated volume models.

item.title: GWM Picks Bulgaria for First European Plant as SAIC's Overseas Sales Pass 1.16 Million
item.description: GWM will build the Ora 5 in Lovech, Bulgaria from Q1 2027 with planned capacity of 50,000 a year, while SAIC's Jan–Sep overseas sales hit 1.166 million and MG topped 280,000 in Europe.

item.title: XPeng Ships the Mona L05 to 65 Markets as GAC and Changan Plan to Take Driver Assistance Abroad in 2027
item.description: XPeng began global shipments of the Mona L05, targeting 65 countries and regions, Chery's Luxeed plans six NEV models abroad, GAC and Changan aim to take driver assistance overseas in 2027, and BYD passed 150,000 deliveries in Australia.

item.title: Chery Breaks 200K Monthly Export Record as BYD, Geely & SAIC-GM Redefine China's Global Push
item.description: Chery hit 202,533 exports in July (+70.1% YoY), BYD set a record 179,841 overseas deliveries (+124.3%), and SAIC-GM renewed their JV to 2047 with a Buick Electra E7 export mandate starting October.

item.title: Google Maps Is Now a Checkout Counter. The Car's Screen Is Next.
item.description: Google Maps can now turn local intent into food orders, hotel choices and event tickets. For Chinese automakers going global, the strategic question is who owns the transaction layer on the dashboard.

item.title: China Just Exported a Year's Worth of Cars in Seven Months
item.description: China exported 6.40 million vehicles in the first seven months of 2026, matching its full-year 2024 volume. Export value rose even faster as the electric-vehicle and higher-priced mix strengthened.

item.title: China Exported 5.31 Million Vehicles in H1 2026. The Bigger Story Is the Powertrain Shift
item.description: China’s vehicle exports crossed 5.31 million units in the customs-based series, but the most important change is beneath the headline: plug-in hybrids supplied almost half of the increase in new-energy vehicle exports, while growth spread across Europe, Latin America and Asia.

item.title: Forty Years of Two Mapmakers: The Technology Converged. One Question Remains.
item.description: Field-survey sect versus probe sect: after forty years the two mapmakers' technology converged, leaving only a choice of commercial philosophy.

item.title: The Anti-Google Map Alliance Now Says It's AI Infrastructure
item.description: Three and a half years on, Overture dropped 'anti-Google' and made AI the subject — buying what the old story couldn't.

item.title: There Are No New Stories in the Map Industry
item.description: Every 2026 map-industry headline is a rerun of scripts Tele Atlas played out forty years ago.

item.title: The First Company to Drive Every Street in America
item.description: From a 1984 wrong turn to Nokia's $8.1B at the top: Navteq's forty-year parabola contains every commercial law the map industry ever learned.

item.title: HERE Won't Go Bankrupt. It Will Disappear.
item.description: Company and assets parting ways is not a new script. HERE as an independent pole vanishes — in four possible forms.

item.title: One Is Waiting for a Buyer. One Is Waiting for Orders.
item.description: Neither HERE nor TomTom will die — but their survival odds differ by an order of magnitude, for reasons no income statement records.

item.title: The King Who Never Sold a Map
item.description: Everyone sells maps as a product; Google raises the map as an organ of Search. Forty years of map wars are a war between two valuation functions — and the space beyond Google's.

item.title: Giving Places an ID: The Foundation AI Agents Are Missing
item.description: AI has no stable way to refer to a place. GERS wants to be the DNS of the physical world — the grounding layer agents are missing.

item.title: Google's OEM Partnerships in 2026: The Four-Layer Stack from Phone Projection to OS to Map Data
item.description: An updated strategy analysis: Google's automaker cooperation splits into four independently purchasable layers — Android Auto projection, the open-source AAOS kernel, the Google built-in service pack, and the Google Maps Auto SDK data layer. We re-sort Volvo, GM, BMW, Toyota, Mercedes-Benz plus XPeng, BYD, Zeekr and Xiaomi by how much OS sovereignty each cedes, and correct the nature of the XPeng and Rivian deals.

item.title: China Auto Overseas Daily | 2026-07-22: BYD Hits 100,000 EVs in Brazil and Enters Japan's Kei-Car Market as XPeng Launches the L03 in Munich
item.description: BYD built its 100,000th EV in Brazil on July 16, signed a PSG sponsorship and will enter Japan's kei-car market with the Racco on July 28, while XPeng launched the L03 globally from Munich and the EU moved closer to taxing Chinese PHEVs.

item.title: Chery Automobile (9973.HK): Stock Valuation and Shareholder Structure Deep Dive
item.description: Chery’s export engine is accelerating while its domestic brands diverge. An ownerless governance structure, a roughly 7x trailing earnings multiple and a large September lock-up expiry frame the investment debate.

item.title: From Suitcase to Landlord: Google's Decade Inside the Car
item.description: GM is removing phone projection while deepening its use of Google's embedded stack. The apparent contradiction explains how Google moved from a guest on the screen to infrastructure inside the cockpit—and why Chinese automakers are becoming the next growth vector.

item.title: In-Car AI Will Be Won by the Need, Not the Model
item.description: Google's advantage in the third generation of in-car assistants is not Gemini alone. It is the ability to anchor conversational AI to a hard-to-cut requirement: global maps and navigation.

item.title: China's Auto Exports Cross 1M Units in June as BYD, Geely and XPeng Push Global Offensive
item.description: China exported a record 1.037M vehicles in June (+75.1% YoY), with NEVs topping 50% of the total for the first time, as BYD overseas sales hit 175,349 units and Geely crossed 100,000 exports in a single month.

item.title: China's Auto Exporters Post Blowout H1 2026: Chery at 944K, BYD at 792K, Geely Tops 100K in a Month
item.description: Chery, BYD, and Geely collectively posted record H1 2026 export figures—943,817, 792,256, and 474,228 units respectively—as Leapmotor entered Mexico and GAC, Changan, SAIC, GWM, and FAW all hit new overseas milestones.

item.title: China Auto Exports Hit New Highs in H1 2026: BYD, Chery, Geely All Surpass 100k Monthly
item.description: BYD hit a record 175,349 overseas units in June (+94.7%), Chery posted 191,062 (+79.7%), and Geely broke 100k for the first time, as China's export boom spreads beyond its traditional duopoly.

item.title: Twenty Points That Redefine Whether Your Car Should Know the Speed Limit
item.description: Euro NCAP's 2026 Speed Assistance rules turn speed-limit knowledge into a measurable safety function, testing camera-map fusion, data freshness, V2X and iACC execution.

item.title: Momenta Deep Dive: Technology, Global Clients and China's Overseas Advanced ADAS
item.description: A full research report on Momenta's HKEX listing, technology roadmap, global OEM clients, map-free ADAS architecture, overseas deployment and the globalization of China's advanced driver-assistance software.

item.title: Automotive Cybersecurity Regulation Deep Dive: UNECE R155, Global Landscape and China Export Implications
item.description: A full regulatory deep dive on UNECE R155, ISO/SAE 21434, China's GB 44495/44496 framework, US connected-vehicle restrictions and cybersecurity implications for Chinese automakers overseas.

item.title: China Auto Overseas Daily | 2026-07-09: Exports Carry June, UK Shows Chinese Model Pull
item.description: China exported 877,000 vehicles in June as domestic demand stayed weak; in the UK, MG HS and Jaecoo 7 entered June's top-10 registrations while Finland showed BYD's trust barrier.

item.title: Mazda EZ-60 / CX-6e Global Sales and Market Strategy Report (2026)
item.description: A full research report on Mazda EZ-60 / CX-6e global sales, covering China sales data, Europe and Australia launch strategy, overseas forecasts, manufacturing, supply chain and strategic risks.

item.title: Mazda EV Strategy Deep Research Report (2026)
item.description: A full research report on Mazda's EV strategy, covering the MX-30 lessons, Lean Asset Strategy, Changan Mazda EZ-6/EZ-60 track, Skyactiv EV platform delay, hybrid strategy, market layout and risks.

item.title: Leapmotor Lands in Mexico, BYD Posts 792K H1 Overseas, XPeng L03 Eyes 64 Markets
item.description: Leapmotor becomes first Chinese EV startup in North America via Stellantis, as BYD hits 792,256 overseas units in H1 2026 (+70.7%) and XPeng prepares a 64-market L03 global launch.

item.title: DELIVAN Deep Research: Chery Commercial Vehicle's Electric Van Export Playbook
item.description: A structured research brief on DELIVAN, Chery Commercial Vehicle's new electric light-commercial-vehicle brand, covering brand strategy, product technology, Europe entry, partners, manufacturing, tariffs and competition.

item.title: Chery Overseas Full Value Chain Layout: Deep Research Report (2026)
item.description: A structured research report on Chery Automobile’s overseas value-chain layout, covering R&D, manufacturing, brands, supply chain, channels, local talent, ESG, capital markets and strategic risks.

item.title: Chery Commercial Vehicle Overseas Sales Forecast: 2025-2030
item.description: A bilingual forecast model for Chery Commercial Vehicle's overseas sales path from roughly 40,000 units in 2026 to a 400,000-unit overseas target by 2030.
